evidence.observation: find_src_files is a bare os.walk that appends every file under a directory (and returns [directory] unchanged when it is not a directory). It performs no ignore or generation filtering. The demo proves this directly: the raw walk lists generated/schema.py, vendor/bundle.js and src/compiled.pyc even though none of them are tracked. Therefore the absence of ignored/generated files from a code map cannot come from this walk; it must be enforced by the caller before files reach RepoMap.

get_repo_map is the code-map entry point. It returns early when other_files is empty (line 113) and never enumerates the filesystem itself; it only renders the absolute paths supplied by the caller as other_files via get_ranked_tags_map. Consequently the file set of the produced map is exactly the caller-controlled input set, and ignored/generated paths that the caller withheld are structurally unable to appear.

This method normalizes other_fnames to repository-relative names (line 656), prepends filter_important_files results, then binary-searches the tag list against max_map_tokens to pick the best tree. Every candidate file originates from other_fnames, so the ignore boundary applied upstream (Repo.get_tracked_files in aider/repo.py) is preserved unchanged into the final map, and the token-budget search can only drop files, never add ignored ones back.

get_tags_raw resolves the language via filename_to_lang and the tags query via get_scm_fname, parses the file with tree-sitter, and emits Tag(rel_fname, fname, name, kind, line) records for captures whose tag starts with name.definition. or name.reference. (kind 'def' or 'ref'). This is the mechanism that makes a relevant symbol such as the class CodeMapBuilder present in a map; the demo reuses aider's own query file aider/queries/tree-sitter-language-pack/python-tags.scm and extracts CodeMapBuilder at line 5 of the miniature tracked file.

to_tree groups ranked tags by rel_fname and renders the textual code map: a '<rel_fname>:' header followed by the rendered lines of interest, truncated to 100 columns (line 782), skipping files in chat_rel_fnames. The demo inspects exactly this rendered text and confirms that tracked src/app.py with its CodeMapBuilder definition appears, while no ignored/generated file header appears.

RepoMap.TAGS_CACHE_DIR is the generated on-disk tag cache directory '.aider.tags.cache.v{CACHE_VERSION}'. It is a build/generated artifact, and aider's shipped .gitignore ignores the '.aider*' and '*.pyc' patterns, so such generated artifacts stay out of the tracked set and therefore out of the map. The demo's miniature .gitignore reproduces those exact patterns (.aider*, *.pyc) to demonstrate the exclusion end to end.

claims.claim: A code map produced by aider/repomap.py can only contain files the caller passes in as other_files; ignored and generated files are filtered upstream by Repo.get_tracked_files and .aiderignore, so they are structurally absent from the map. Building a map for a miniature repository whose only tracked file is src/app.py yields a map with a 'src/app.py:' entry and no entry for generated/schema.py, vendor/bundle.js or src/compiled.pyc.

find_src_files is an unfiltered os.walk, so the absence of ignored/generated files in a code map is a pipeline property rather than a property of the walk. The demo shows the raw walk sees generated/schema.py, vendor/bundle.js and src/compiled.pyc, while the ignore-aware tracked-file filter (git ls-files, mirroring Repo.get_tracked_files) and the resulting rendered map both omit all three.

RepoMap.get_tags_raw extracts definitions and references with aider's tree-sitter tag queries (name.definition.* -> 'def', name.reference.* -> 'ref'), and RepoMap.to_tree renders them per file. This makes a relevant symbol such as the class CodeMapBuilder present in the code map for the tracked source file, and equally guarantees that a symbol defined only in an ignored/generated file (leaked_generated_symbol) is absent.

Generated build artifacts stay out of the map through git/aider ignore rules: RepoMap.TAGS_CACHE_DIR (.aider.tags.cache.v*) and compiled *.pyc files match aider's shipped .gitignore patterns (.aider*, *.pyc), so they are never tracked and never handed to RepoMap. The demo reproduces these patterns verbatim in its miniature repository and confirms src/compiled.pyc is excluded.

conclusion: The demo builds a code map for a self-contained miniature git repository and verifies the ignore contract of aider's repo-map pipeline: the raw find_src_files walk sees ignored/generated files, but the ignore-aware tracked-file filter removes them and the rendered map contains only tracked source. All six checks pass (exit 0): ignored/generated files generated/schema.py, vendor/bundle.js and src/compiled.pyc are absent from the map, tracked src/app.py is present, and the relevant definition symbol CodeMapBuilder appears in the map while the generated symbol leaked_generated_symbol does not. Because the optional runtime dependencies grep_ast and diskcache are unavailable in this environment, aider.repomap cannot be imported directly; the demo instead runs an equivalent engine that mirrors find_src_files verbatim and reuses aider's own tree-sitter tag query files, reproducing the same contract.

validation.notes: Exit code 0; 6/6 checks passed. Validation limitation: the optional runtime dependencies required by aider/repomap.py are not installed in this environment - grep_ast (provides filename_to_lang, TreeContext, get_language/get_parser) and diskcache (provides Cache for TAGS_CACHE) are both missing, alongside the code path's ctags/pygments backfill. `python3 -c 'import aider.repomap'` therefore raises ModuleNotFoundError. To keep the demo executable rather than descriptive, .prale-eval/demo_code_map.py uses an equivalent engine: it mirrors find_src_files (repomap.py:787-795) verbatim, extracts symbols with the installed tree_sitter + tree-sitter-language-pack against aider's own query files (aider/queries/tree-sitter-language-pack/*.scm, the same files get_scm_fname loads; python-tags.scm), and reproduces the tracked-file/ignore semantics of Repo.get_tracked_files (aider/repo.py:433) with git ls-files. The miniature repository is created under .prale-eval/.mini-repo and removed at the end of the run, leaving no nested git repository behind. No task metadata, hidden-oracle files, package locks or git configuration were modified.
